content.text:
Yes. Your eye is right. Current idiom branch has inconsistent vertical rhythm. Main pattern:

> `32px airy band → 36px unpadded heading → 54px row → 64px action → 32px airy band`

Feels loose, then pinched, then loose again. Not refined yet.

Audit used local `feat/dai-idiom-rebuild`, current uncommitted state. Desktop rendered in Helium. Responsive behavior source-inspected. No edits made.

## Section-by-section findings

| Area | Current spacing | Verdict |
|---|---:|---|
| Site header | `56px` height | Good. Compact, readable. |
| Hero chart | `394px` tall at desktop rail | Good. Dominant without wasted blank space. |
| Name line | `32px / 32px` line-height, zero vertical padding | Too cramped. Name touches surrounding rules. |
| Role line | `14px / ~20px`, inside `36px` band | Fine alone. Abrupt after tight name line. |
| Hero → Overview | `32px` hatched band | Slightly too much. |
| Overview | `16px` padding + `32px` icons = `64px` | Internally good. Too small relative to adjacent `32px` bands. |
| Overview → Projects | Another `32px` band | Repetition makes hatch dominate content. |
| Projects heading | `30px / 36px`, zero vertical padding | Biggest cramped area. |
| Project rows | `16px / ~22px`, `16px` top + bottom | Good. Keep. |
| Expanded project text | `15px / 24px`; `16px` before tags | Good, slightly generous but intentional. |
| “All projects” | `32px` button + `16px` top/bottom = `64px` | Too loose. Taller than project row. |
| Blog heading | Same zero-padding `36px` title | Cramped. |
| Blog row | `16px` title at `~22px`; `8px` to metadata | Good. |
| Search indexes | `36px` unpadded title → `52px` search band | Poor transition. Heading pinched, input comparatively roomy. |
| Article toolbar | About `44px` | Good. |
| Article title | `24px` top/bottom | Good for wrapping title. |
| Article metadata | `14px / 21px` + `20px` top/bottom = `61px` | Too loose for one line. |
| Article body lines | `19px / 32.3px`, ratio `1.7` | Slightly too airy. Lines disconnect. |
| Paragraph gap | `21.85px` | Fine after tightening line-height. |
| `h2` before-space | `47.5px`; `14.25px` after | Good hierarchy, mildly loose. |
| `h3` before-space | `38px`; `14.25px` after | Good. |
| Post neighbours | `16px` padding, `4px` label/title gap | Good. |
| 404 content | Mostly `16px` padding | Good, but title inherits cramped panel heading. |
| Footer opening band | `48px` | Too much. |
| Footer row | About `56px` desktop | Good. |
| Footer wordmark | About `140px` at desktop rail | Strong, intentional. |
| Footer fade spacer | `96px` | Too much after already-large wordmark. |

Key sources: [profile-header.tsx](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/components/profile-header.tsx:160), [panel.tsx](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/components/panel.tsx:22), [page.tsx](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/app/page.tsx:36), [globals.css](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/app/globals.css:573), [site-footer.tsx](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/components/site-footer.tsx:23).

## Root cause

No real spacing hierarchy. Same few values serve unrelated meanings:

- `8px`: icon gaps, metadata gaps, search shell padding.
- `16px`: rows, panel bodies, expanded details, action bands.
- `32px`: every home section divider.
- `48px` and `96px`: footer-only expansion.

Values themselves are reasonable. Assignment is not. Section boundaries need stronger space than internal groups, but headings also need breathing room. Current design gives boundaries space while squeezing headings.

## Fix direction

Recommended focused pass:

1. Add `py-2` to ordinary panel titles.
2. Reduce home divider `32px → 24px`.
3. Reduce footer divider `48px → 32px`.
4. Reduce “All projects” wrapper `py-4 → py-3`.
5. Reduce article metadata `py-5 → py-4`.
6. Reduce prose leading `1.7 → ~1.62`.
7. Reduce footer fade spacer `96px → 64px`.
8. Keep hero height, overview internals, project rows, blog rows, toolbar, post-neighbour tiles.

This should remove both problems without redesigning anything.

Mechanical Impeccable layout detector returned no findings. That means no obvious overflow/arbitrary-layout violation. It cannot judge visual rhythm. Latest [Web Interface Guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines/main/command.md) also define layout safety, not numeric spacing quality.

Two adjacent polish violations remain: `transition-all` in [overview.tsx](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/components/overview.tsx:49) and [not-found.tsx](/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/app/not-found.tsx:85).

Verdict: structure good. Rhythm unfinished. Heading bands, separators, article leading, footer tail cause almost all discomfort.
